from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = ["Six dots should make thirty-two.", "The circle actually creates thirty-one.", "The pattern of powers crashes!"]
        self.setup_layout("The Counter-Intuitive Discovery", lecture_lines)
        
        # Animations
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Show 3 cuts forming a central triangle using /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/circle.svg as reference points. (Color #FFFFFF)
        circle_img = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/circle.svg", color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(circle_img, 'B4', scale_factor=0.6)
        
        # We use a circular path equivalent to the svg
        circle = Circle(radius=1.2, color=WHITE).move_to(circle_img.get_center())
        line1 = Line(start=circle.point_from_proportion(0), end=circle.point_from_proportion(0.33), color=WHITE)
        line2 = Line(start=circle.point_from_proportion(0.33), end=circle.point_from_proportion(0.66), color=WHITE)
        line3 = Line(start=circle.point_from_proportion(0.66), end=circle.point_from_proportion(0), color=WHITE)
        
        self.play(Create(circle_img), Create(line1), Create(line2), Create(line3), run_time=2)
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FFFFFF")
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight 7 total pieces clearly using /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/circle.svg to mark each segment. (Color #FFFF00)
        regions = VGroup(*[Dot(point=circle_img.get_center() + np.array([i*0.2, j*0.2, 0]), color=YELLOW) for i, j in [(-0.5, 0.5), (0.5, 0.5), (0, 0), (-0.5, -0.5), (0.5, -0.5), (0, 0.8), (0, -0.8)]])
        self.play(FadeIn(regions), run_time=2)
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FFFF00")
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Contrast with expected sequence 1, 2, 4, 8 using /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/circle.svg to visualize the numerical growth. (Color #FF0000)
        seq = Text("1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32... NO! 31", font_size=30, color=RED)
        # Applying fix for VideoCritic issue 29
        self.place_in_area(seq, 'E3', 'E5', scale_factor=0.65)
        self.play(Write(seq), run_time=2)
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FF0000")
        self.wait(2)
